tool.name: ampvis2 alpha diversity
tool.description: Calculate alpha-diversity indices for each sample and combine with metadata.
tool.command: Rscript -e "library(ampvis2); library(vegan); data <- readRDS('$input'); result <- amp_alpha_diversity(data, rarefy = $rarefy); write.table(result, file='$output', sep='\t', quote=FALSE, row.names=TRUE)"
tool.help: Calculates alpha-diversity indices for each sample and combines with metadata using the `amp_alpha_diversity` function from the ampvis2 package.
